title: Replacement of Mediator
description: Replacement of mediator by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission

steps.step: The District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission receives information from the mediator or any other person, including parties to the complaint
The Commission is satisfied with the information and decides to replace the mediator
The Commission replaces the mediator with another mediator

content.authority: District Commission or State Commission or National Commission
